summary: Iteration 14 — Lawyer marketplace + Razorpay LIVE migration. Backend: 20/20 pytest passing (lawyer register returns role='lawyer' + httpOnly cookies, /lawyers/me shape={user,profile,verified=false default}, duplicate email 409, public /lawyers lists verified-only including seeded Adv Ravi id 69e4f192664052de23481578, POST /lawyers/me persists rate/bio/spec, /lawyers/me/reviews returns list, admin /admin/lawyers lists all (12), admin /admin/lawyers/verify flips true/false and list visibility updates, non-admin 403, book-lawyer 404 for no-will, 404 for unverified lawyer/bad id, book-lawyer returns razorpay_key_id='rzp_live_SfOCoLA1sIzYKf' + amount=fee*100 + order_id, verify-signature mismatch → 400 'Signature mismatch', endorse pending → 400, endorse bad token → 404, /billing/create-order monthly returns rzp_live_ key, demo-login+role=lawyer auth still green). Frontend: /lawyer/register renders + submit → /lawyer; /lawyer dashboard renders stats+profile; adv.ravi@estima.com login → /lawyer (role redirect); demo→/lawyer→/app role-guard works; /app/will Browse Estima Counsel modal opens with 1 verified lawyer card (Adv Ravi Menon ₹4,000 per review, Book button); /app/admin Lawyers tab renders 12 rows + 6 Verify/Revoke buttons.
action_items: (Optional) Consider exposing 'verified' at the top level of GET /api/lawyers/me response (currently nested under profile) for easier frontend consumption — currently the dashboard uses me.profile.verified which is fine, so non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Lawyer marketplace block (/app/backend/server.py lines 4848–5212) is cleanly appended after @api_router decorators and include_router was correctly moved to bottom (line 5215+) — all endpoints registered and reachable.

POST /api/will/book-lawyer wraps razor_client.order.create in try/except and returns 502 on gateway failure — good. Returns razorpay_key_id straight from RAZORPAY_KEY_ID env (verified: rzp_live_SfOCoLA1sIzYKf). platform_fee_inr is rounded int of fee*PLATFORM_FEE_PCT/100 (10%) — correct.

POST /api/will/book-lawyer/verify uses hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature) — constant-time comparison, safe. Lawyer earnings credited = fee - platform_fee, notify email on success, non-fatal exception on email failure — good.

POST /api/public/will-review/{token}/endorse is idempotent (returns {already:True}); correctly bumps lawyer.endorsement_count and sets will.lawyer_endorsed=true only when review.status=='reviewed'; pending → 400.
GET /api/lawyers sorts by (-endorsement_count, rate_inr) and exposes only public fields — no password_hash leak. Uses str(_id) → id; _id never surfaced.
Admin routes /admin/lawyers + /admin/lawyers/verify gate on user.role=='admin' → 403 otherwise. GET strips password_hash via projection.

Frontend Will.jsx bookLawyer flow dynamically loads checkout.razorpay.com then instantiates new window.Razorpay({key: data.razorpay_key_id, ...}) — passes LIVE key unchanged; handler POSTs to /will/book-lawyer/verify with signature. Matches spec.
LawyerDashboard.jsx role-guards in useEffect by redirecting any non-'lawyer' user to /app — confirmed working in UI test (demo user on /lawyer → /app).
Login.jsx post-login redirect already correctly routes role==='lawyer' to /lawyer (verified: adv.ravi login lands on /lawyer dashboard).
server.py is now ~5222 lines (grew from 4851). Modularization (domain routers) becomes more urgent; loan/will/lawyer/billing could be split into /app/backend/routers/*.py.
ObjectId usage in book_lawyer wraps lawyer_id in try/except — good (prevents bson.errors.InvalidId leaking as 500).

Minor: GET /api/lawyers/me response structure {user, profile} is inconsistent with GET /api/lawyers item shape (flat with id/name/rate_inr...). Not a bug, but frontend needs to know. No code fix needed — frontend already handles both shapes correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (7/8 critical flows — Razorpay rzp.open mock interception didn't fire due to SDK script overwrite, but backend test confirms rzp_live_ key is returned by /will/book-lawyer and Will.jsx passes data.razorpay_key_id directly to new window.Razorpay)
